models.name: AXI-Mantle v1.2 (Axisymmetric Segment, Implicit FEA)
models.what_it_computes: Time-dependent viscoelastic creep strain, principal stress, hydrostatic stress, and crack driving metrics (cohesive damage evolution, energy release rate proxies) within a 2D axisymmetric cement mantle segment with explicit stem–cement and cement–bone interfaces.

models.name: PS-Construct v0.9 (Patient-Specific 3D Construct, Implicit FEA)
models.what_it_computes: Spatial distributions of creep strain, multiaxial stress, interfacial tractions, and cohesive damage in a subject-specific femur–cement–stem assembly with contact, porosity-informed elastic–viscoelastic properties, and localized defects.

mechanisms.name: Monotonic crack initiation under impaction-like and early postoperative loads
mechanisms.why_it_matters: High local tractions and residual stress concentrations can nucleate microcracks in the mantle, compromising early stability and accelerating failure.

mechanisms.name: Time-dependent creep under sustained joint reaction and hoop stress
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Creep relaxation and strain accumulation can thin load paths, alter fit, and elevate interfacial stresses, predisposing the mantle to later cracking.

mechanisms.name: Creep–fatigue interaction during daily cyclic activities
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Creep-induced stress redistribution modifies fatigue hot-spots, enabling small cracks to coalesce and propagate under physiologic cycles.

deviation.detail: All credibility factor scores are reported on a 0–12 Evidence Rating scale with defined anchors (0, 3, 6, 9, 12) for each factor, provided separately for every model × mechanism pair.

findings.mechanism: Monotonic crack initiation under impaction-like and early postoperative loads
spans: In AXI-Mantle, the axisymmetric geometry is intended to isolate radial and circumferential mechanics of the mantle adjacent to a nominally axisymmetric stem profile, capturing rim effects and canal pressurization cleanly.

The stem–cement and cement–bone interfaces are represented by a combination of contact with Coulomb friction (coefficient 0.05–0.20, depending on surface finish) and cohesive surfaces with traction–separation laws that allow mixed-mode damage initiation and evolution.
findings.span: In AXI-Mantle, the axisymmetric geometry is intended to isolate radial and circumferential mechanics of the mantle adjacent to a nominally axisymmetric stem profile, capturing rim effects and canal pressurization cleanly.

findings.mechanism: Creep–fatigue interaction during daily cyclic activities

findings.mechanism: Monotonic crack initiation under impaction-like and early postoperative loads
spans: A global patch test with prescribed displacements on a subdomain of cement reproduced uniform stress states with <0.1% deviation.

A manufactured solution for linear viscoelasticity in a 3D block with spatially varying prescribed body forces produced L2-norm errors below 0.30% at the finest mesh and first-to-second order convergence as expected for quadratic tetrahedra under the chosen integration scheme.
Contact with friction was benchmarked against a cylinder-in-tube press fit, reproducing analytical radial pressure distributions and stick–slip transitions within 6.2% RMS error.
findings.span: A global patch test with prescribed displacements on a subdomain of cement reproduced uniform stress states with <0.1% deviation.

findings.mechanism: Monotonic crack initiation under impaction-like and early postoperative loads
spans: For the impaction-like and early postoperative scenario, we implement a quasi-static ramp of axial load from 0 to 2.5 kN and torsional moment up to 8–10 N·m over 2–5 s, superposed on a residual canal pressure of 0.2–0.3 MPa to represent the effect of pressurization.

The three simulated loading regimes bracket the 5th–95th percentile ranges of hip contact magnitude (0.8–3.2 body weight) and torsional moment (4–12 N·m) reported for early standing and gait, and include a residual canal pressurization of 0.2–0.3 MPa during seating, which ensures the excitations are representative of clinical conditions relevant to the intended questions.
